// defid.ts — THE DEFAULT EXPORT WHOSE DECLARATION *IS* THE NAME.
//
// A third one-default module rather than a third line in exp.ts, and the reason
// is the grammar: a module may hold at most one default export, so the three
// arms of `default_internal` / `default_anonymous` cannot be separated inside
// one file. exp.ts carries the `id` arm, def.ts the anonymous one, and this
// carries the arm a rule reading `id` alone gets wrong.
//
// MEASURED FROM THE SCANNER: babel gives an Identifier a `name` attribute and
// NO `id` child, so `export default q` is reported anonymous by the arm that
// answers for `export default function named() {}` — and it is not anonymous.
// `q` is a name in THIS module, which is the whole distinction section 5c draws
// between a local export and a re-export.
const q = 1;
export default q;
